spec.title: SSHadowForge / Developer
spec.description: For a developer using the forge: what happened to my repositories -- commands, builds, scans, merges, notifications -- and, when something is slow or failing, whether it is me or the forge.

spec.title: Forge accepting
spec.description: Share of gateway requests failing with 5xx across EVERY repository. Green here and a refusal in your repository: look at your command's result below.

spec.title: Submit p95
spec.description: How long `sfd-submit` waits for the gateway, forge-wide.

spec.title: Forge alerts
spec.description: Anything the operators are being paged about.

spec.title: Merge queue
spec.description: Events waiting for the dispatcher: approvals, pushes and dispositions ahead of yours. It handles one at a time.

spec.title: Build queue
spec.description: SSHadowForge jobs waiting for capacity. Your build may be one.

spec.title: Runners busy
spec.description: Builds, scans and challenges running now, forge-wide.

spec.title: Commands
spec.description: Accepted and refused commands against the selected repositories after authorization.

spec.title: CVE matches
spec.description: The worst repository's matches in its latest scan.

spec.title: Builds by repository and result
spec.description: Finished builds in the last 24 hours.

spec.expr: sum by (repo, result) (((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[24h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[24h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""} offset 24h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[24h]))) > 0

sum by (repo, result) (((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""} offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h])))

spec.title: Where my builds failed (24h)
spec.description: The runner stage a failed build stopped at. `sfd-tui` shows the pull request's status; the operator can read that stage's log.

defaults.noValue: no scan read for these repositories yet

spec.title: Merge decisions
spec.description: gated: a requirement is unmet (usually the build has not passed yet). stale_head: pushed after approval, re-approve. stale_base / conflict / not_fast_forward: rebase and re-approve.

spec.expr: sum by (repo, decision) (((increase(sfd_merge_decisions_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_merge_decisions_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) unless sfd_merge_decisions_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""} offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_merge_decisions_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h])))

spec.title: Commands by kind
spec.description: Issues, pull requests, comments, approvals, retries...

spec.title: Refused commands
spec.description: Refused AFTER authorization (enrolment, wrong key, parent missing, an outage). A refusal before authorization carries no repository: see 'Refused before authorization'.

spec.title: Refused before authorization (forge-wide)
spec.description: Not enrolled, wrong key, forbidden, unauthenticated: usually a credential on the laptop (`make login-keys`, `sfd-submit enrol`).

spec.title: Notifications
spec.description: Chat notifications to the repository's chit channel.

spec.expr: sum by (repo, outcome) (((increase(sfd_notifications_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_notifications_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) unless sfd_notifications_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""} offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_notifications_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h])))

spec.title: Build requests
spec.description: Builds the dispatcher requested for a pull request head; retried = a `retry` from the TUI.

spec.expr: sum by (repo, reason) (((increase(sfd_build_requests_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_build_requests_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h]) unless sfd_build_requests_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""} offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_build_requests_total{repo=~"$repo",repo!=""}[1h])))

spec.title: Is it me or the forge?
